BUY-74715.auditSummary: Two Railway services in BuyWhere have PAPERCLIP_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY set as an env var AND a startCommand preamble that would write it to /paperclip/instances/default/secrets/master.key if the env var is non-empty: outbound-link-probe (01c004ff) and buywhere-api (945e8a6d). The preamble originated in api/railway.json (Richmond Teo, commit 350a7a4a2, 2026-05-31) and propagated through Vera's BUY-71229 commits and Wave's BUY-74650 reset. Other 11 services have neither. Remediation: (a) commit clean api/railway.json (Rex, this commit), (b) scrub PAPERCLIP_* env vars from both services via Railway UI (Richmond, child issue), (c) delete outbound-link-probe (Richmond, BUY-74711), (d) consider rotation of PAPERCLIP_SECRETS_MASTER_KEY (Richmond + Paperclip operator, child issue).
